note: Samurai, front view, left (image-left) hand resting on and gripping the pink wrapped hilt of the sword at his hip. Head is the dark hair, ears and goatee, bottom y~432 at the goatee tip; the blue-grey collar, cream armour, belt, kimono panels and the sheathed katana end poking out at the right hip (x662-722, y730-790) are torso. Left arm: blue sleeve upper arm (x316-392, y498-600) to the elbow y~600 where the grey gauntlet begins, grey gauntlet forearm to the wrist y~648, gauntleted fist with peach fingertips y646-700. The pink tsuka and its cream pommel pointing down-left (x226-330, y688-762) are equipment since the hand grips them; this is borderline between held and worn-at-belt, and the blade is hidden. Right arm: blue sleeve upper arm to y~600, grey gauntlet forearm to the wrist y~650, hand with grey glove block and fingertips y648-722. Under the grey hakama the hip is the hem (y~835); the bare skin strip below is thigh to the boot tops (y~852), where the knees are; boot shafts are lower leg to the ankles (y~898-900), boot toes are feet.
